metadata.methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed stimuli on an LCD monitor at 150 cm. EEG was recorded from 32 head and face electrodes (left mastoid reference) at 500 Hz with a DC to 200 Hz bandpass. Fifty semantic-category and fifty identity-category line drawings were each presented twice, once after an unrelated distractor word and once after a related distractor word (200 ms prime). Participants named each picture aloud as quickly as possible, verbal responses were recorded via a headset, and trials were self-paced with a button press. Raw data were imported into EEGLAB and saved as .set files.
